headline: Competition committee to study whether coal prices are justified and whether excessive markups are applied
summary: Uzbekistan's Competition Committee is examining whether coal prices charged to consumers are economically justified. It will check that exchange-sourced domestic coal does not carry excess markups and that dominant firms do not raise prices unjustifiably.
why: Coal is a key energy input for power generation and industry, so price regulation affects energy costs and the producers and distributors selling it.
